s01050.summary: Odalys sits in her funeral dress as brushes sweep the car
Odalys recalls her late husband never washing the car and leans on the wheel
As the dryer blasts, Odalys laughs, then stops
She puts the car in drive and rolls out into the light

pd_dollhouse_1.summary: Nora tells Christine how she secretly scrimped and copied to repay the loan
Nora teases Christine with a fantasy of a rich old admirer's will
Nora rhapsodizes about being free from care and the coming spring
The bell rings and Krogstad arrives, unsettling Nora and Mrs Linde
Mrs Linde asks about Krogstad and reveals she once knew him

s01085.summary: At 2 a.m. Imogen half-reads while Suleiman carefully loads his washer
Imogen remarks on his folding habit; they trade dry quips about Tuesdays
They discover they are both night-shift nurses on adjacent floors
Suleiman recalls passing her on the stairs with a croissant; she hides a smile
Her lone sock matches one in his pocket; they agree on Tuesday
She leaves her sock in his palm and walks out into the rain

s01058.summary: Colter prepares to shave beardless Magdalena, who quips it'll be quick
Magdalena steers small talk to the sheriff and points out his boots
Colter combs nervously, noting she knows his name; she waits
She demands the sheriff's whereabouts, revealing her brother rode out with him
Magdalena coldly calls Colter a man with a good alibi; boots appear at the door
She seats the shaking barber and takes up his razor to talk

pd_sisters_0.summary: On Irina's name-day Olga recalls their father's funeral a year ago
Olga longs for Moscow; Irina and Olga dream of selling up and going
Irina feels joyful; Olga admits weariness and wishes she were married
Tuzenbach announces Vershinin's visit and gossips about his troubled wife
Soleni muses on strength while Chebutikin notes a hair remedy

s01104.summary: Marshal Dunmore rides up to the water tower where Odessa and Lazarus wait
Odessa explains the Whitaker brothers escaped up the tower, armed
Lazarus asks if he'll shoot them; Dunmore answers with dry humor
Fort Bell promises reinforcements by noon; Dunmore says they'll be too late
Dunmore returns Odessa's rifle, shares a silent look, and climbs the ladder

s01113.summary: The crew finds cryo pod 17 cold and empty; Pixie jokes uneasily
Odalys insists Santiago open the pod despite his hesitation
Inside lie a blanket, a child's drawing, and a dead monitor
Santiago gently stops Pixie from touching the monitor
Odalys has the pod sealed and pockets the drawing as Miriam comforts her

pd_sisters_6.summary: Amid tearful bustle Trofimov hurries everyone toward the waiting train
Lopakhin locks up; Anya bids farewell to the old life and all exit
Lubov and Gaev sob quietly, saying goodbye to the orchard and their youth
The house is locked and carriages leave as the axe sounds
Ailing Fiers finds himself locked in and forgotten, and lies down still

s01087.summary: Hosea works the lock as the impatient Captain Arden complains about time
Clementine corrects Ezekiel's timing; Perpetua hides amusement and urges patience
A rope snaps; Clementine and Hosea wrestle the yawing barge straight
Officers on the towpath order the barge to halt in the Crown's name
Ezekiel, suddenly humble, urges Hosea to open the upper gate
Hosea decides, opens the gate, and the barge escapes into the dark

s01025.summary: Barnaby and Aloysius enter Fitch's lost-and-found to claim a trunk
The pair fumble their story while Aloysius lets slip the Mortimer papers
Fitch produces the trunk with shirts and a folio; the men fight over the pen
Hortense bursts in with Nell about a toy that isn't lost
Hortense needles the men; Nell exposes her matchmaking scheme
Fitch reveals the folio is a deed they've been selling the ship with
The pair bolt and jam in the doorway; Hortense resolves to buy the ship

pd_earnest_2.summary: Cecily resists her German lesson and teases about Uncle Jack's seriousness
Cecily wishes Jack's wicked brother could visit; Prism disapproves
They spar over diaries, memory, and Prism's lost three-volume novel
Dr. Chasuble arrives and Cecily invents a headache for Prism
Chasuble's metaphors fluster Prism, who accepts a stroll and leaves with him

s01022.summary: Mabel works the switchboard alone, connecting calls in the night
A stranger barges in demanding the Harrisburg line; Mabel refuses
Crowe shows credentials; Mabel doubts them and he demands the manager
Mabel wakes Abernathy; mention of the six-ten freight changes his tone
Toby bursts in reporting the wire cut at Calder bridge
Mabel questions Crowe; Toby spots copper wire in his satchel
As the sheriff comes on, Mabel orders Crowe to stay and has the door locked

s01068.summary: Exhausted Evelyn sways alone in the marathon hall, asking the void for a cigarette
Jack emerges from the shadows to share a cigarette and banter
Jack offers his hand and they dance, joking about the prize money
They speak the same promise at once, laugh, and she asks him to hold on

s01080.summary: In a cramped arbitration room, Pike clicks his pen and Yusupova fidgets
The arbitrator reviews the heat complaint and notification letters
Yusupova describes the landlord's dog-smelling blanket, which the arbitrator records
Pike seeks nine thousand dollars; Yusupova keeps the warm blanket

s01056.summary: The Duchess convenes her crew on the abandoned carousel
Slim lays out the four-million heist in the carousel's still column
The Duchess explains forged permits and assigns Pearl to drive and pick locks
Bones reveals a sixth share for an unknown partner in Lavalle's ledger
The Duchess confronts Lavalle, who coolly admits he told her what she needed

s01106.summary: Hazel calls out Jonah for missing the ferry again
Eavesdropping Wendell interjects; Hazel sides with him, defusing the fight
They laugh, the horn blasts, and Jonah softly apologizes

s01078.summary: June counts quarters alone at the rink concession in 1989
Danny arrives early and waits, the two pretending not to notice
June shares free popcorn and they eye-roll over Mr. Pruitt
Danny shows a missing-person flyer of his sister Rosalind
June reveals Pruitt's locked room with Rosalind's jacket on the door
Danny demands to see it; Pruitt opening the rink forces June to stall
June slips Danny the keys and he vanishes into the crowd

s01098.summary: At the funeral home Rosemary belittles Benedict's competence
Delphine claims a place in the will; Rosemary admits striking it
Rosemary silences Benedict; she and Delphine trade barbs about blood
Rosemary sags; Benedict touches her arm and they recall the deceased
All three break into laughter and tears together
Price asks if they're ready; Delphine sits beside Rosemary facing the casket

pd_dollhouse_5.summary: Rank knocks late; Helmer grudgingly lets him in
Rank and Helmer banter about the evening's champagne and merriment
Nora probes Rank's investigation; he hints at certainty of his fatal diagnosis
Nora changes the subject to costumes; Rank compliments her as a fairy

s01112.summary: Nadia calls a rest stop at the glacier despite Nat's objection
They share a thermos and Nadia points out the distant pass
Injured Desmond insists he can walk; Nat and Nadia refuse to let him crawl
Nat tethers Desmond to the sled, calling him the anchor
Into the wind, they haul the sled toward the pass in silence

s01092.summary: Coach and lone rower prepare in silence, talking past each other
Hester pours tea for Pascal, who ignores it
Hester needles his terse replies until he smiles and takes the mug
They acknowledge no one's coming and remember the full squad and Camille
Pascal fears missing the cut; Hester says they'll row anyway
They lift a single shell together and carry it into the mist
